items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Tyree and the rest of the musicians got tired of seeing that horn laying up there doing nothing. So, the band started playing the last number -- the band started playing "Spozin'" and Tyree handed me the horn right on television. So I had to do something. I picked it up -- I didn't even know what ke

ctx.x: Yes. Oh, it was a beautiful valve trombone. It was a rare instrument. It had a very large bell -- in fact, later as I learned how to play it and I showed up on a television show one night, Tyree was on the show. Tyree Glenn. So I took my horn and I laid it up on the organ hoping somebody would ask me to play. And Tyree fell in love with my horn. From then on, I had to guard it because he wanted it real bad.
